$comment: ADR-420: dedicated dock / shipyard art. The atlases have NO image files of their own: their pixels are painted at runtime by apps/client/src/task420-art.ts (software rasterizer -> blob URL, the Task 34 / ADR-356 pattern) and the sources override in view.ts points the registry at those blob URLs, so the image/ktx2 paths below are never fetched. They point at a real pack atlas only because the pack test requires every manifest atlas to name a PNG + KTX2 twin that exist on disk. Atlas layout is a plain grid (frame() math): 4 cols x 2 rows of 128px, cols = damage stages 0-3, rows = rotation 0 (front) / 1 (side). building.frames uses the same rows: frames[rot][stage].
name: survivaz-task420
